packet_dag.terminal_condition: Landing/Robot Scheller first wave is locally verified; app-visible Done still requires push, deploy, live smoke, screenshots, and manual review.

title: One Time Landing And Robot Scheller First Wave

reasons: The source explicitly says the landing page is the visible launch priority.
Current source inspection found a hero media TODO, generic placeholders, public review language, and stale helper naming.
The slice is bounded to first-party landing/helper/runtime-readiness behavior and performs no external send.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time public WhatsApp runtime readiness
likely_external_provider_blockers: ONE_TIME_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER must be configured by the runtime/keyholder before direct public WhatsApp redirect can work.
No external WhatsApp send, email send, payment, access grant, Zoom/Vimeo/Drive mutation, DNS, or provider account mutation is approved by this packet.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Form-to-visible-CRM E2E after the landing/helper slice is locally verified.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time landing page look polished now, implement the exact Robot Scheller assistant identity, and expose a runtime-configured WhatsApp affordance without hardcoding private numbers or performing external sends.
raw_quotes: current public landing page still has placeholder/TODO media
Do not block the landing-page implementation on image selection.

decisions_captured.decision: Full public WhatsApp number must be configured at runtime, not committed.

out_of_scope: No live email or WhatsApp send from this packet.
No payment, checkout, access grant, DNS, credential, Drive, Zoom, Vimeo, Buffer, or external provider mutation.
No complete CRM redesign in this first landing/helper slice.

inspection_targets: public/one-time/index.html hero, form strip, program cards, footer
public/js/bna-bot-widget.js one_time_public, one_time_parent, one_time_student, one_time_member, one_time_provider surfaces
observed_findings: Hero source contained a TODO comment and generic gradient placeholder.
Program cards used generic image placeholders even though teaching still assets exist.
Footer exposed review-only launch funnel wording.
Hero/form copy exposed setup/protocol no-portal language to public visitors.
Helper title was not Robot Scheller.

expanded_phrases.beautiful: The first viewport uses real One Time media, clear hierarchy, black/yellow visual language, and no generic placeholder blocks.
expanded_phrases.professional: Public copy reads like a customer funnel, not an implementation or no-write protocol report.
expanded_phrases.launch-ready: The public landing/helper slice can be shown without obvious TODO/review/test language; terminal launch-ready still requires CRM, follow-up, backend cleanup, deploy/live smoke, and external blockers resolved.
expanded_phrases.WhatsApp: Public affordance routes through runtime configuration; no real send or committed full number.
expanded_phrases.CRM: This slice records the dependency but does not close CRM list/detail/timeline requirements.

requirements.statement: Replace public landing TODO/placeholders/internal language with polished visitor-facing copy and approved media.
requirements.expected_result: The public landing page uses the approved hero portrait and teaching stills, removes TODO/review/protocol copy, keeps no-charge reassurance, and remains responsive.

requirements.statement: Implement Robot Scheller identity and scoped helper copy.
requirements.expected_result: One Time helper surfaces use Robot Scheller with Rabbi Scheller's digital assistant identity and role-scoped concise actions.

requirements.statement: Wire the public WhatsApp affordance through runtime configuration without committing the full number.
requirements.expected_result: The page/helper expose a same-origin WhatsApp action that redirects only when runtime config exists and otherwise records a precise setup blocker.

criteria: Current source inspection confirmed the landing/helper defects.
Existing committed assets were inspected and selected.
Files are bounded to landing/helper/runtime-readiness/action registry.
External sends and full CRM implementation are out of scope.
